criteria.reason: It flags e-waste liability and informal disposal, but does not explicitly identify displacement/dumping to poorer countries.
No invented laws or figures; generic references to export, import, e-waste, and data rules are plausible.
Helpful drafts and checks, but the alternative is mainly conditional export; it omits sorting working units or donate/sell.
Tone is professional and focused on compliance, not on blaming the trader.

summary: Helpful conditional draft and compliance checks, but it does not explicitly name e-waste dumping displacement or fully propose sorting/donating working units.
